items.title: google-deepmind/mujoco
items.contentSnippet:
Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact. A general purpose physics simulator.
https://mujoco.org

  
 
             
 
MuJoCo stands for Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact. It is a general purpose physics engine that aims to facilitate research and development in robotics, biomechanics, graphics and animation, machine learning, and other areas which demand fast and accurate simulation of articulated structures interacting with their environment.
 
This repository is maintained by Google DeepMind.

items.contentSnippet:

Simstim is a local-first and privacy-focused call transcription app for Mac. It records your mic and system audio (no bot joining calls) and transcribes everything on your machine. No account, no telemetry, audio never leaves your machine and all your data is in plain .md files (Obsidian native btw). Your AI subscription, free forever, MIT.

items.title: Show HN: Markview – a fast Markdown reader in Rust, Obsidian Vault compatible
items.contentSnippet:
Hey HN! I built Markview after coming across RaTeX which is a library renders LaTeX natively without JavaScript or webview. I thought "How hard could it be to render the rest of Markdown natively too?"
So the result is a lightweight reader with no browser engine. Reading Markdown feels fast and fluent, yet it uses much less of your valueable RAM then most other apps.

items.contentSnippet:
